puzzle.hint: Personal accountability — a powerful declaration that one's reward comes only from one's own striving and effort, not from lineage, status, or others' deeds.
puzzle.arabic: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
puzzle.verseEn: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives
